Distance optimizations.

perks.name: Tactical Heatsink

perks.name: Cooling Baubles

Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.desc: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Built to Blast
perks.desc: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

perks.name: Hip-Fire Grip
perks.desc: Increases accuracy, stability, and precision hit targeting when firing from the hip.

perks.name: Proximity Power
perks.desc: When targets are nearby, final blows grant bonus Melee stat.

perks.name: Rangefinder
perks.desc: Aiming this weapon increases its effective range and zoom magnification. Increased projectile velocity while aiming Rocket Launchers, Grenade Launchers, and Bows.

perks.name: Delicate Tuning
perks.desc: While at low heat, this weapon has improved range, handling, and accuracy.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Kill Clip
perks.desc: Reloading after a kill grants increased damage.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

perks.name: Repulsor Brace
perks.desc: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield.

perks.name: Thermal Atomization
perks.desc: While at high heat, this weapon deals increased damage and causes targets to explode when defeated.

perks.name: Accelerated Assault
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads a small amount of ammo from reserves, or removes heat, and slightly increases damage.

perks.name: Air-Cooled Core
perks.desc: Sprinting increases vent or reload speed for a short time. While at low heat or full magazine, gain increased handling and movement speed when aiming down sights.

notes: Inspired by https://www.youtube.com/@Legoleflash (PvP PvP-Duel PvP-God M+KB Controller): God-roll PvP for duelling in 3s and 6s. Compact Defender is, at time of writing, an A-Tier option for skilled players who can manage the Dynamic Heat frame and probably a B-Tier for the rest of us. "A sidearm that makes your first fight easier and still lets you 4-tap afterwards" according to Lego. Heat frames are like having an extra perk set, first providing a pseudo-Reconstruction, automatically "refilling" as the weapon loses heat when not being used. Additionally, Dynamic Heat weapons have an intrinsic ×1.025 damage boost against Guardians in Crucible, plus a ×0.5 heat generation for 6s if you manually reload when the heat bar is at <12.5% of maximum heat to proc Dynamic Heat Limiter, as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. On top of that you also get the Lightweight frame boosts of +20 to Mobility and ×1.0625 base movement speed. The @hugowo_ spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/, shows a base TTK of 0.667s (4c 1b). The stats are a bit mixed when comparing to other lightweights - good stability and ammo generation, but bad recoil direction, but as the only one that offers tiered rolls, you can get enhanced barrel, mag, weapon mods and origin traits to help out at Tiers 4 and 5. You can see the in-game effect of stat changes at https://d2foundry.gg/w/2819552809 for yourself. Range is highly compressed on sidearms so, for a controllable PvP roll aim for a total Range of around 43 and Stability of 70 with your barrel and heatsink perks, Masterwork and mod. While Rangefinder might seem the obvious pick, Delicate Tuning works like a Heat weapon's mirror to Closing Time, boosting Range by +20 (+22 when enhanced), Handling and Accuracy when a weapon's cold, with the benefits reducing to half at 50% heat. Enhanced Precision Instrument boosts Precision Instrument's crit damage by ×1.2 which means a very forgiving 0.667s (3c 2b) - but if you can run a weapon stat of 164 and two Void surge mods, picking up an orb after a kill will reduce the TTK to 0.5s (4c 0b) - the same as Kill Clip, but without having to get a kill first. You can see the play loop demonstrated in Lego's video. The Air-Cooled Core can be useful in PvP - when at <10 heat you gain Handling and improved ADS speed for the start of a duel, and after sprinting for 0.5s you'll gain improved vent speed. Accelerated Assault sounds good, providing 10% cooling and ×1.05 damage when you hit 3 times with 0.8-1.2s between each hit, but it takes at least 1.6s to proc, so you're not likely to see any benefit within a normal TTK window. Recommended MW: Stability, Range or Ballistics, with a Range or Stability enhanced mod, or your choice depending on your play style.

Inspired by @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for Minor add group control in general at-level or better content, particularly on Void builds. Compact Defender is a Dynamic Heat pulse rifle which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic, providing an intrinsic ×1.15 damage boost against red-bar enemies and ×1.325 against orange and yellow bars and vehicles, plus a ×0.5 heat generation if you manually cancel a vent animation at <12.5% of maximum heat, as per the https://www.destiny2.science/ Destiny Data Compendium. The stats are decent by comparison with lightweight sidearms, which are the closest comparators - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/2819552809 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. With any fast firing weapon, improving recoil control can be useful, but otherwise looks for Handling on M+KB, and maybe extra Stability on controller. For the battery perk, Overclocked Heatsink provides free ×1.02 damage for a slightly slower vent speed - not a problem if you manually reload anyway - Particle Repeater helps Stability or Light Heatsink or Tactical Heatsink improve gunfeel. For Void synergy, the tried and trusted trait perk combination of Destabilizing Rounds, which spreads Volatility on a kill in a 6.5m radius and provides Volatile Rounds for 4.5s (5.25s when enhanced) to clear Minor add groups, and Repulsor Brace - provides a ×0.5 damage resisting Void overshield for 8s (10s when enhanced) after killing a void-debuffed enemy. With this being a CQC primary, the overshield can be very useful for tanking damage. For the Origin Trait Air-Cooled Core improves handling and ADS speed when heat is <10%, and boosts Vent Speed for 6s after sprinting. If you're very lucky you'll drop a weapon with the much better option of Accelerated Assault which passively reduces heat by 10% and boosts damage by ×1.05 for getting 3 hits within 1.6s. If you're interested, it's modelled after the Defender sporting blaster pistol used by Princess Leia Organa in the opening scenes of Star Wars: A New Hope. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost heat generation, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

For add clearing and void synergy, there's the double damage perk combination of Destabilizing Rounds, which spreads Volatility on a kill in a 6.5m radius and provides Volatile Rounds for 4.5s (5.25s when enhanced) to clear Minor add groups, and Thermal Atomization to boost damage by between ×1.08 and ×1.14 as heat increases from 50% to 100%, and then proc a 7.5m AoE Void explosion on a kill, spreading volatility even further. For the Origin Trait Air-Cooled Core improves handling and ADS speed when heat is <10%, and boosts Vent Speed for 6s after sprinting. If you're very lucky you'll drop a weapon with the much better option of Accelerated Assault which passively reduces heat by 10% and boosts damage by ×1.05 for getting 3 hits within 1.6s. If you're interested, it's modelled after the Defender sporting blaster pistol used by Princess Leia Organa in the opening scenes of Star Wars: A New Hope. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost heat generation, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
